plan.summary:
The sync no longer visits archived projects.

- `syncAll` in `src/sync/run.ts` skips any project with `archived` set.
- Skipped projects are not synced and are not counted in the returned total.
- A formatting-only change in `src/sync/report.ts` is left out.
plan.riskRationale: One guard clause in a loop. The change is small and local. It does change which projects get synced, so the skip condition should be checked.
plan.storyArc: One change: `syncAll` skips archived projects. The skip happens before `syncProject` runs and before the counter goes up.

topics.title: Skip archived projects in syncAll
topics.narrativeBrief: What does syncAll do with archived projects now? Show that the new `continue` runs before `syncProject` and before `synced++`, so skipped projects are not counted. Verify that `Project.archived` is a defined field and check how callers use the returned count.
